name: zclass_typelist_count_nodes
description: zClass_TypeList::CountNodes walks a callback bucket's live link chain and returns the number of nodes.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass type-list/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44ec90 validates fastcall bucket in ecx, loading the bucket head from g_zClass_TypeList_HeadSlotPtrs[bucket], walking each link's next field at offset 8, and returning the visited-node count.
The native smoke inserts nodes into bucket 7 and verifies CountNodes returns the expected live-link count.
